steps: Sign in to the OpenAI platform (platform.openai.com)
Name it after your project; keep the default permissions or restrict them
Click 'Create secret key' and copy the key - it is shown exactly once
Admin keys and some restricted keys may not be allowed to list models, so the check can fail for a real key

limited.meaning: the key is accepted but may not be allowed to list models (a restricted key without that permission); it will do what you gave it. A 403 can also mean your country is not supported

least_privilege.summary: Choose 'Restricted' permissions for just the endpoints you use, on a project made for this app.

unverified: validate.limited (OpenAI's docs do not say what a restricted key without model access gets; a wrong key is a 401)

steps: Find the leaked key in the list (check every project)
Click the trash (Revoke) button and confirm
